purpose: Screen every county economic panel record for later treatment-year-specific comparison research without treating an inventory absence as proof that no data-center project was considered.
review_scope: Known exposure is derived from the repository's active canonical-facility inventory and the data-center-only stopped-proposal registry. No county-wide negative-evidence audit has yet been completed.
negative_evidence_rule: A county with no linked facility or stopped proposal remains unresolved_negative_evidence. It must not be described as never considered, never treated, untreated, or eligible for a causal donor pool.
eligibility_rule: Control eligibility is treatment-year-specific. A county can become eligible only after the required evidence domains are audited through the applicable treatment year and pre-treatment panel diagnostics pass.

required_negative_search_domains.label: County and municipal planning, zoning, and land-use records
Economic-development agreements, incentives, bonds, and tax abatements
Utility, grid-interconnection, transmission, water, and wastewater records
Air, water, environmental, and generator permitting records
Deeds, options, site-control records, and named development parcels
Company announcements and data-center trade reporting
Local news, public meetings, petitions, litigation, and organized opposition

future_matching_requirements: Use only values observed before the treated county's event year.
Require adequate outcome coverage and comparable pre-treatment levels and trends.
Screen adjacent counties, shared utility territories, and regional labor markets for spillovers.
Record major contemporaneous shocks and competing large developments.
Re-evaluate eligibility separately for every treated county and outcome geography.
